title.en: EU reaches agreement to simplify AI rules, responding to industry compliance complaints
title.zhHans: 欧盟达成简化 AI 规则协议，回应行业合规负担诉求

searchSummary.en: EU institutions agreed to simplify selected AI Act requirements in May 2026. The AI Omnibus entered into force on July 27, fixing later compliance dates for high-risk systems and extending some simplified obligations.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟机构于 2026 年 5 月同意简化部分 AI 法案要求。AI Omnibus 于 7 月 27 日生效，为高风险系统确定了更晚的合规日期，并扩大了部分简化义务的适用范围。

summary.en: On May 7, 2026, the European Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement to streamline selected EU AI Act requirements. The resulting AI Omnibus entered into force on July 27. It moved the application date for Annex III high-risk systems to December 2, 2027 and for high-risk systems embedded in Annex I products to August 2, 2028.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 5 月 7 日，欧洲理事会与欧洲议会就简化部分欧盟 AI 法案要求达成临时协议。由此形成的 AI Omnibus 于 7 月 27 日生效。它将 Annex III 高风险系统的适用日期调整至 2027 年 12 月 2 日，并将嵌入 Annex I 产品的高风险系统适用日期调整至 2028 年 8 月 2 日。

narrative.en: The May agreement responded to implementation concerns about documentation, classification, and the readiness of compliance tools. Its July entry into force converted the political agreement into binding amendments. The Omnibus extends some proportional obligations to small mid-cap companies and expands access to regulatory sandboxes. It also retains other AI Act obligations on their original timetable. Legal and policy analysts disagree about whether the delayed deadlines reduce unnecessary burden or weaken safeguards before the regulatory system is fully operating.
narrative.zhHans: 5 月的协议回应了文档、分类和合规工具准备情况带来的实施问题。7 月生效后，政治协议转化为具有约束力的修正案。AI Omnibus 将部分比例化义务扩展至小型中型企业，并扩大监管沙盒的适用范围。AI 法案的其他义务仍按原有时间表执行。法律与政策分析人士对延后期限的效果存在分歧：它可能减少不必要的负担，也可能在监管体系完全运行前削弱保障。

description.en: The entry into force converted a provisional simplification agreement into binding amendments with fixed compliance dates for major high-risk AI categories.
description.zhHans: 此次生效将临时简化协议转化为具有约束力的修正案，并为主要高风险 AI 类别确定了固定合规日期。

text.en: The European Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on May 7, 2026 to streamline selected EU AI Act requirements.
text.zhHans: 欧洲理事会与欧洲议会于 2026 年 5 月 7 日就简化部分欧盟 AI 法案要求达成临时协议。

text.en: The AI Omnibus entered into force across the EU on July 27, 2026.
text.zhHans: AI Omnibus 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日在欧盟范围内生效。

text.en: The Omnibus deferred the application dates for specified high-risk AI systems while extending some simplification measures.
text.zhHans: AI Omnibus 延后了部分高风险 AI 系统的适用日期，并扩大了部分简化措施。

text.en: Policy analysts argue that delayed deadlines can reduce protections as well as administrative burden.
text.zhHans: 政策分析人士认为，延后期限既可能减少行政负担，也可能削弱保护。
